text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happy come come, New Year!
Doto-san, Trainer-san,
Happy New...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where's Doto-san?

"We had planned to celebrate the New Year together,
but no matter how long we waited, Meisho Doto never showed up."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeeeeh? Wasn't our promise
to go for Hatsumode todayyy?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*, where are youuu?
Traineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? Is that... Ayabe-san?
Visiting the shrine alone on New Year's...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (I wonder what she's wishing for. Such a serious look on her face. And... she looks kind of lonely...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, they're leaving...
Is it okay to just... leave them be?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... Aya, Ayaya,
Ayabe-san!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...? You are...
...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, uh, well...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'll b-b-buy you takoyakiiii!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
“I see, was my face really looking that gloomy...?
And so...”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees. Plus, since they won at
Hanshin the other day, I couldn't help it~

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So... takoyaki...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I know you were just being considerate of me.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, no! More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Why did you have such a
troubled look on your face?
What did you wish for...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What is it that you run for?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? The reason why I run?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes. Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That's, um... I guess I want to
gain confidence, or, well...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am... running for the sake of "the other me."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For my younger sister, who was born alongside me—
and perished that very same day.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I have to shine for two all on my own... for my sister's sake as well.
I must shine; nothing less will be forgiven."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So—I swore before the gods.
That in this one Classic year, I'd dedicate as many wins as possible to my little sister.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
For your sister...
So that's what drives you, Ayabe...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, my reason to run.
If I looked grim, that's why."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Does this make up for the takoyaki?
Well, I'm heading out now."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Doto-san is here, we found her!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
*sniffle* Waaaaaaah!

The moment we met, Meisho Doto burst into tears.
After calming her down and asking what happened...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Is that so... Ayabe-san had such a terribly unlucky past...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've...
I've been wrong all this time...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was just my body that wasn't enough.
But... my heart is, too.
My resolve is nowhere near enough either.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san runs carrying a tremendously heavy burden. Something like fate itself.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san also says, "It is my mission to bring
happiness to all with my brilliant radiance."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I... I just...
I just wanted to have confidence in myself...
I had no reason other than for my own sake..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: At this rate, even if my body grows, there's no way I can reach it! Waaaahhhhh!

Her loud wails echoed all around.
I understood how she felt all too painfully. But...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, don't cry!
Please don't cry, Doto-san!
There's definitely still hope!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer's gonna give me some great encouragement! Look, see, see? C'mon, Trainer, hit me with something good~~~!
choice_data_list: Because my heart's hitting a growth spurt too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: My heart is... hitting a growth spurt too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Not just my body... but my heart too?
Is that... how it is?
Is that why my wishes are so... small?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly, that's right! Big wishes
are something you can think about later!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Doto-san is still in the middle of finding herself.
With time and a little bit of luck,
things will work out for her.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I guess... you're right.
I hope... that's true...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Understoood~ With that belief in mind, I want to do things that will help me grow~

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, let's do that.
It is the first one of the new year, after all.
Trainer, what should we do?
For a change of pace, it might be good to have her do something. If I were to let her do something...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, sounds great. A New Year's mountain hike!
Well then, have a safe trip!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyawawawawa, a suspension bridgeee!?
T-This, anything but this, please~~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"If I try to cross, it'll go *creeeak!* *CRACK!* 
and whoooosh! I'll fall right through~."
choice_data_list: Well, do you want to pass on it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-B-But I can't stay timid forever~.
Time to take on the challengeee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ready, and, DASH!
Teyaaaaaah!
(CRACK CRUNCH SNAP!!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawawaa, barely made it safe!!!!!

In the nick of time, Meisho Doto sprinted across the bridge.
Thanks to that, she built up her courage.
Yes, by building on your growth step by step like this, we'll have you aim steadily for the top this spring.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, that sounds wonderful. A department store basement tour!
I'll be looking forward to souvenirs from the lucky bags too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaaaa... Trainer-san,
it's the sweets corner. There's so many sweet,
delicious-looking treats...
choice_data_list: Shall we eat in the trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh, are you sure I can buy it?
Hwaaa... Such bliss right from New Year's~."

Growth requires nutrition, too. Since she cried so much
today, it's best to let her have a warm, cozy rest.

On the way back, a thought crossed my mind.
There's no need to rush yet. This spring,
I'll let her aim for the top slowly and steadily.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, New Year's games! Flying kites and
spinning tops, let's give 'em a try!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaaah, Traaaineer,
the kite, the kite crashed into the ground
and smashed to smithereens."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaah, the top, the top went swoosh
right off the string, awawawah."

No matter what she tries, Meisho Doto is always in a clumsy flurry.
Yet through her play, she seems to have picked up all sorts of techniques.

Indeed, there's no need to rush just yet.
This spring, let's have her aim for the top
slowly and steadily.
